positions.title: Senior Application Developer (Salesforce)
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Establishing integration to make Salesforce the single source of truth.
Initiating and managing continuous vendor relationships.
Writing and maintaining technical documentations.
Working with Salesforce Admins to monitor and escalate tickets for system errors.

positions.title: Salesforce Consultant
positions.description: Salesforce Consultant providing technical recommendations and providing optimal solutions for various companies.

positions.title: Salesforce Developer
positions.description:
- Develop dynamic applications within the Salesforce CRM cloud platform.
- Experienced in object oriented programming using Apex and SOQL to engineer back-end solutions.
- Proficient in designing and implementing both visualforce and lightning component frameworks.
- Knowledgeable of salesforce's out of the box tools to automate business processes and visualize data. 
- Collaborated in agile teams to satisfy project requirements, client requests, and business goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full Stack Developer involving design, analysis and building next-gen software systems, including business applications, games, computer applications, middleware, and network control systems across a variety of industries, including finance, insurance, retail, healthcare and government.

positions.title: Target Protection Specialist
positions.description:

Ensuring assets are properly secured and protected
Auditing and updating inventory counts
